name: versus-v16-character-persistence-probe
description: Verify selected profiles and meshes survive death, respawn and a new match in the explicit mechanics probe.

replacements.old:
local Vector ProbeLocation;
    local float RemainingCooldown;

Log("HPVersusMechanicsProbe START A=" $ string(A) $ " B=" $ string(B));
        A.ServerSelectVersusSpell(1);

replacements.new:
VersusProbeResult(!B.IsVersusSpeedBoosted() && B.Health == 100,
        "new-match-clears-speed");
    VersusProbeResult(ProbeAPRI.SelectedCharacter ~= VersusProbeCharacterA
        && ProbeBPRI.SelectedCharacter ~= VersusProbeCharacterB
        && A.Mesh == class'HPVersusCharacterProfiles'.static.GetMesh(
            VersusProbeCharacterA)
        && B.Mesh == class'HPVersusCharacterProfiles'.static.GetMesh(
            VersusProbeCharacterB),
        "character-profile-survives-new-match");
